scripts.check: pnpm types:generate:check && pnpm --filter @luksuzni-prevoz/site check && pnpm --filter @astro-foundation/core check
scripts.audit:deps: pnpm audit --prod || (echo '⚠ Dependency audit found vulnerabilities (see above). Review advisories; the gate does not hard-fail on transitive build-tool vulns (sharp/esbuild) that are not shipped in dist/.' && exit 0)
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @astro-foundation/core test:unit && pnpm --filter eslint-plugin-astro-foundation test:unit && pnpm --filter @luksuzni-prevoz/site test:unit
scripts.generated:sync: pnpm types:generate && pnpm theme:sync && pnpm components:sync && pnpm traceability && pnpm design:sync
scripts.generated:check: pnpm types:generate:check && pnpm theme:sync:check && pnpm components:check && pnpm design:sync:check && pnpm traceability --check
scripts.quality:fast: pnpm generated:check && pnpm governance:validate && pnpm skills:validate && pnpm foundation:doctor && pnpm theme:validate && pnpm design:self-test && pnpm design:doctor && pnpm design:detect --strict && pnpm routes:validate && pnpm content:validate && pnpm seo:validate && pnpm lint && pnpm check && pnpm test:unit && pnpm parse-waivers
scripts.quality:release: pnpm quality:page && echo "Scanning the production build for secrets..." && pnpm secret-scan && echo "Auditing production dependencies..." && pnpm audit:deps
scripts.design:governance: pnpm governance:validate && pnpm design:sync:check && pnpm design:doctor && pnpm design:detect --strict
scripts.design:guard: pnpm governance:validate && pnpm skills:validate && pnpm components:check && pnpm design:sync:check && pnpm design:doctor && pnpm design:detect --strict && pnpm check
